hints.title: Single-Character Edit Graph Shortest Path
hints.text: View gene strings as graph nodes where edges connect sequences differing by exactly one character. Use breadth exploration to find minimum mutations.

hints.title: Mutating Positions Over 4 Nucleotides
hints.text: At each node, generate candidate mutations by swapping each position with A, C, G, or T, checking whether the candidate exists in the gene bank.

hints.title: Level Order Queue Traversal with Bank Lookup
hints.text: Convert bank into a set. Enqueue startGene with step 0. While queue is non-empty, pop node. If node matches endGene return step. Mutate each position; if neighbor in bank, remove from bank and enqueue.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: B: number of genes in bank
complexity.notes: Optimal breadth-first search finding shortest mutation path in linear time proportional to bank size.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Depth-first search risks exploring long sub-optimal mutation cycles.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Hash set representation of bank enables constant O(1) membership checks.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should check early that endGene exists in the bank before running search.
